summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy form published to the ASX. The EGM is scheduled for September 11, 2026, to be held virtually. The filing is a routine meeting notice with no special-situation event described, such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms or strategic actions are disclosed. The filing merely provides procedural details for shareholders to attend and vote. Accordingly, this is not classified as a special situation.
